speechInteraction.attemptCounterRule: Only a valid scored evaluation consumes one attempt.
speechInteraction.failedEvaluationRule: A network, recording, transcription, or evaluation system failure returns to retry_ready and does not consume an attempt.

assignment.playerIdentity: A is first homepage code; B is second homepage code
assignment.roundPattern: Odd rounds A=read_aloud and B=question_answer; even rounds reverse
assignment.nextGameRule: Every new game restarts from the same round-1 pattern

readAloud.timeCorePolicy: For clock items, a wrong or missing hour, minute, or o'clock core slot caps total at 59.

questionAnswer.acceptableAnswerRule: Every listed acceptable answer is independently eligible for full credit.
questionAnswer.contractionEquivalence: Target-aware contracted and expanded forms are canonicalized before scoring; raw transcript remains unchanged.

analysisUse.accentTolerance: Natural reduction or an intelligible accent difference does not automatically fail a student.
